create_ScaleCostWeight: create a ScaleCostWeight with a scalar or tensor to uniformly scale cost function errors
create_DiagonalCostWeight: create a DiagonalCostWeight with a sequence or tensor to apply per-dimension cost weights
use_weight_error: use the weight_error method on a CostWeight to scale an error tensor by the cost weight
use_weight_jacobians_and_error: use weight_jacobians_and_error to simultaneously weight a list of jacobian tensors and an error tensor
use_is_zero: use the is_zero method on a CostWeight to check which batch entries have zero weights
